_comment: Keycloak Admin → bundle-5 realm → Realm Settings → Import (bottom of page)
OR via Admin Console: Manage → Import
OR via CLI: kcadm.sh create partialImport -r bundle-5 -f record-locator-realm-partial.json
This file adds two client scopes and two clients to the existing bundle-5 realm.
It does NOT recreate the realm or touch any existing config.
1. Go to Clients → record-locator-node → Credentials → copy the client secret
2. Go to Clients → record-locator-api → Credentials → copy the client secret
3. Set those secrets as env vars on your deployments (see README below)
ENV VARS for the Record Locator app itself:
(This is already the default in application.yml — only set it to override)

clientScopes.name: record-locator:read
clientScopes.description: Read-only access to FHIR endpoints (ITI-67 search, ITI-66 list, ITI-68 retrieve). Grant to clinicians and HIE consumer systems.

attributes.consent.screen.text: Read patient document pointers from the National Record Locator

clientScopes.name: record-locator:write
clientScopes.description: Write access to ingest endpoints (/pointer-events, /consent-events). Grant only to hospital nodes and Bundle-2a consent webhook clients.

attributes.consent.screen.text: Submit document pointers and consent decisions to the National Record Locator

clients.name: Record Locator — FHIR API (read-only)
clients.description: Clinician-facing FHIR client. Gets record-locator:read scope only. Use for HIE portals, clinical workstations, and any system that queries patient document pointers.

clients.name: Record Locator — Hospital Node (read + write)
clients.description: Hospital node client. Gets both record-locator:read and record-locator:write scopes. Use for hospital systems that POST pointer-events and consent-events. One client per hospital, or one shared client for all nodes in dev/staging.
